bibl.title: Helen's Phantom in Fragments.
bibl.seg: Kirk Ormand, Helen's Phantom in Fragments.
Christos Tsagalis (ed.), Poetry in Fragments. Studies on the Hesiodic Corpus and its Afterlife = Trends in Classics. Supplementary Volumes. 50 (Berlin - Boston, 2017) pp. 115-134.
bibl.note: The Hesiodic Catalogue of Women explicitly uses the technique of interacting intertextually, in a highly allusive way, with other poems within the Greek mythic tradition. In particular, fr. 23a refers deliberately to Stesichorus' innovation of an eidolon that replaces Helen in the stories of the Trojan war.
